source: Free POST https://api.machgen.ai/api/v0/adapters probes on 2026-11-11 (reserve a custom-LoRA upload; docs https://www.machgen.ai/docs/rest_api/custom-loras#1-reserve). Each sent an invalid request, and MachGen answered HTTP 422 or 400 before reserving anything, so no upload_url was handed out. The pydantic help-link lines are dropped from each detail. The wallet read 15210713 micros before them.
checkOrder: The ?model= query first (422 when missing), then the model (400 'This model does not support adapter uploads' for anything but MiniMax-H3), then size_bytes and md5 (UploadRequest), then the 5 GB size limit, then adapter_config (AdapterConfig), then inference_config (InferenceConfig, its field checks before its sampling rules). Each stage reports only its own errors.
